ABRASIVE.Commentary: This card is mainly about the thorns.  Many enemies in STS2 multiattack, making this an excellent source of passive damage when combined with a defense-heavy deck.  Being able to play a power via Sly is very effective as well.

ACCELERANT.Commentary: This effectively multiplies the damage dealt by poison cards, at the cost of making them tick down faster.  Great with Bouncing Flask or Bubble Bubble to start the poison, terrible if you just have one Noxious Fumes.

ACCURACY.Commentary: One of the better ways to scale physical damage on Silent, provided you have a couple of reusable shiv sources.  Don't take this with only one shiv card.

ACROBATICS.Commentary: This is now one of the best card draw options for Silent thanks to the abundance of Sly targets.  Pair with any 0-cost card or any card that has Sly for best results.

ADAPTIVE_STRIKE.Commentary: Intended to combo with Hologram or All for One.  Also a good card to use with Enchantments as the bonus effects are also duplicated.

ADRENALINE.Commentary: One of the freest clicks in the game since extra draw and energy is always good.  Never skip this unless there's a better rare card being offered.  Goes absolutely nuts with Clone.

AFTERIMAGE.Commentary: Almost any build appreciates the added block from this card, but this works best when you're spamming lots of 0-cost cards like shivs.  Great with multiple copies!

AFTERLIFE.Commentary: This is the most Summon you can get for 1 energy.  Decent card that is held back by being single-use.

AGGRESSION.Commentary: Effectively 1 draw per turn that always gets an attack.  Very useful if you have bonus energy generation or if you can limit the cards that this will retrieve.

AKABEKO.Commentary: The additional damage applies to each hit of your first attack, so this is best with AoE or multi-hit attacks.  8 free damage at worst.

ALCHEMICAL_COFFER.Commentary: Tons of potions right now to help you get smoothly through Act II.  Restock at shops to keep up a stockpile for Boss combats.  Excellent with Delicate Frond in Act III.

ALCHEMIZE.Commentary: 1 potion per fight is a very strong effect allowing you to spend potions aggressively in short fights or save up useful potions for a boss fight.  If you find ways to duplicate or Replay this card, even better!

ALIGNMENT.Commentary: Very powerful energy gen as long as you have stars to spend.  Best used alongside big spenders like Heavenly Drill or Prophesize.

ALL_FOR_ONE.Commentary: Works with a wide variety of cards from numerous different builds.  Try to keep the number of 0-cost cards in your deck below 10 so that you can get all of them.

AMETHYST_AUBERGINE.Commentary: A solid trickle of Gold that you can use to buy more Relics.  Particularly nice if you have the Dragon Fruit to get more Max HP.

ANCHOR.Commentary: What's not to love about Turn 1 Block?  Saves you HP in many fights.

ANGER.Commentary: A remarkably flexible attack that can be used for free damage early game as well as being an endgame damage plan with Strength and card draw.  Combine with Vicious, Pillage, or Battle Trance to draw the growing pile of attacks.  Sometimes you should refrain from playing this card if additional copies would be disadvantageous.

ANOINTED.Commentary: This card is at its best when you have multiple rare cards that work extremely well when drawn together.  For example, Nightmare + Adrenaline on Silent or Supercritical + Echo Form on Defect.

ANTICIPATE.Commentary: Access to Dexterity on a common card is huge for Silent.  Allows scaling your block to tackle the endgame, especially with a good draw engine.

ARCANE_SCROLL.Commentary: Many Rare cards are dead weight at the start of the run, so this can be a big gamble.

ARCHAIC_TOOTH.Commentary: Most of the starter upgrades are very strong.  Best on Ironclad.

ARMAMENTS.Commentary: This card gets better if you can have more cards in your hand at once.  At base value, you can think of as 5 block + 3 block or 3 damage in short fights, but a better use is in giving continual value for longer fights where you redraw the deck.

ARSENAL.Commentary: Powerful strength gain with a few colorless cards in the deck, which works great with Regent's multihit cards.  Note that Sovereign Blade counts as colorless.  Great with Bolas.

ART_OF_WAR.Commentary: An excellent Energy boost for decks with a lot of Skills.  Also great if you need to spend your full turn blocking or playing Power cards.

ASHEN_STRIKE.Commentary: Low-damage attack that scales up very quickly with exhausted cards.  Exhausting more cards will both improve the damage and let you draw this card more often, leading to massive damage output.

ASSASSINATE.Commentary: Basically a super-backstab.  Very helpful against short hallway combats in Act 2 and 3 by letting you burst down one target quickly.  If you need long-term power, consider a different rare card.

ASTRAL_PULSE.Commentary: Very good early game area attack, being just affordable with your starting stars.  Solid all the way into Act 2 and 3.

ASTROLABE.Commentary: Get rid of your Strikes and turn them into something way better!  Often makes a Rare card. Note: Do not use this to transform Curse cards.

AUTOMATION.Commentary: This includes the cards you draw at the start of your turn, so by default this is 1 energy every other turn.  The more card draw you have, the better!  Enables infinites.

BACKFLIP.Commentary: Very solid package of draw and block.  Really appreciates Dexterity for more block.  Great with multiple copies.

BACKSTAB.Commentary: A classic turn 1 card, the idea behind this card is a damage option that you can throw down quickly and not have to draw again.  In longer fights you want to keep re-drawing your block and longterm damage cards rather than a cheap attack, so the exhaust is an upside.

BAG_OF_MARBLES.Commentary: Allows your Turn 1 attacks to do more damage leading to faster engagements.  Much better if you can draw additional cards Turn 1.  Also useful for removing Artifact from enemies.

BAG_OF_PREPARATION.Commentary: Improving your turn 1 is always good.  Accelerates your deck by drawing your key cards earlier.

BALL_LIGHTNING.Commentary: One of the best early-game damage commons.  Estimate this as 15 total damage including 8 from evoking the lightning orb.  Only gets better with Focus or lightning synergies.

BANSHEES_CRY.Commentary: It's a little tricky to get the discount going initially, but the payoff here is massive.  Combine with a good draw engine to keep drawing it at 0-cost.

BARRAGE.Commentary: Surprisingly high damage with 3 filled orb slots.  With bonus orb slots from Capacitor this can be a damage solution for the end game.

BARRICADE.Commentary: Retaining your block can be a very powerful effect, but the high energy cost of this card combined with the need to generate massive block means that it's hard to get this card in play.  Works really well with the colorless cards Panic Button, The Gambit and Prolong.

BASH.Commentary: A usable source of Vulnerable that gets outclassed if you find other debuff sources.  Worth an Act I upgrade if you don't get any more Vulnerable.

BATTLE_TRANCE.Commentary: 0-cost card draw makes this a no-brainer for any deck that doesn't already have a lot of draw effects.  Combo with Headbutt to keep drawing it every turn.

BEACON_OF_HOPE.Commentary: An extremely helpful power for 3- or 4-player games.  Even if you don't make a huge amount of block yourself the other players will appreciate the added output.

BEAM_CELL.Commentary: Very simple yet very effective way to improve Defect's physical damage output.  Works with any attack, but especially nice with Sunder, Claw, or Barrage.  Good floor 1 pick.

BEATING_REMNANT.Commentary: Can save you from losing too much HP on a really bad turn, but mostly does nothing at all. Easy to forget about.

BEAT_DOWN.Commentary: The high energy cost combined with the random choice of cards makes this very difficult to use effectively.  Works best if you can limit the number of potential targets.

BEAT_INTO_SHAPE.Commentary: A little tricky to use - you have to hit the enemy several times and still want big damage from your sword afterwards.  Most useful against Boss enemies.

BEAUTIFUL_BRACELET.Commentary: Effectively draw 9 per fight which is a massive advantage for decks that can make Energy.  Attach this to a card with Innate for guaranteed turn 1 draw!

BEGONE.Commentary: Think of this like a 1-cost attack that exhausts something in your hand.  Minion Strike is colorless and can activate synergies related to colorless cards.

BELIEVE_IN_YOU.Commentary: A very abusable source of energy since this card does not Exhaust.

BELLOWS.Commentary: A nice boost to your performance on turn 1 regardless of what else you draw.  Best if you have any other Relics that draw or create cards on combat start.

BELT_BUCKLE.Commentary: A surprisingly effective defensive boost that encourages you to use your Potions more aggressively.  Particularly good against Boss enemies since you generally want to use your potions there anyway.  Gets worse if you have more Potion slots.

BIASED_COGNITION.Commentary: The most Focus you can get from one card.  There's no way to negate the gradual focus loss, so you'll have to win a few turns after playing this.  Be careful in boss fights!

BIG_BANG.Commentary: Easy take most of the time, giving you a little bit of everything.  Only skip if there's a better rare to take.  Insane if cloned.

BIG_HAT.Commentary: The pool of ethereal cards is quite small, so this relic will make the same cards fairly often.  Has a good chance to give you a copy of Demesne.

BIIIG_HUG.Commentary: The upside of the Relic far outweighs the downside.  4 removed Starter cards will significantly accelerate your game plan.  Most decks will win before the Soot becomes a problem, and there are various ways to Exhaust them as well.

BLACK_HOLE.Commentary: Only deals damage once regardless of how many stars you get or spend, so this is better with a large number of cards with a low star cost such as Cloak of Stars.

BLACK_STAR.Commentary: Rewards you more for Elite fights but doesn't help you beat them in the first place.  Take this only if you're confident your deck can beat Elites as-is.

BLADE_DANCE.Commentary: Great for activating attack relics and does huge damage with either of the Shiv damage powers.  Try not to rely on this as your only Shiv card since you only get one use.

BLADE_OF_INK.Commentary: Shivs that apply Weak, what's not to love?  Worth considering even in decks with no existing synergies.

BLESSED_ANTLER.Commentary: The Dazed will significantly slow down your first deck cycle and can really punish your early turns.  Not advisable unless you have lots of card draw or can benefit from the Dazed somehow.

BLIGHT_STRIKE.Commentary: Relatively efficient damage at the cost of having a portion of it delayed in the form of Doom.  Can hit very hard when combined with Vulnerable or the power Lethality.

BLOODLETTING.Commentary: One of the best ways to get more energy to play cards.  The cost in health is generally offset by the added value of the additional cards you can throw down.  One way to win a run is to add enough draw to your deck to cycle this card repeatedly and use the energy gain to kill bosses before you run out of health.

BLOOD_SOAKED_ROSE.Commentary: The Curse that comes with this is debilitating and becomes even worse if you draw a lot of cards.  Very few effects can destroy the Curse before it inconveniences you.

BLOOD_VIAL.Commentary: 2 HP per fight isn't very exciting, but it does add up.  Good enough if you get it in Act I.

BLOOD_WALL.Commentary: At face value this is 14 block / 2 energy - decent value but made better with self-damage synergies.  Having a huge block card in the common pool makes Body Slam much easier to use.

BLUDGEON.Commentary: Excellent early-game power spike, allowing most Act I encounters to be beaten with ease.  In the mid- or late-game, Bludgeon is best when discounted or multiplied with effects like Pen Nib or Cruelty + Vulnerable.

BLUR.Commentary: A deceptively useful secondary effect.  If you play multiple copies of Blur your block is retained for additional turns.  Great with Burst.

BODYGUARD.Commentary: Summon is a deceptively powerful effect because it retains from turn-to-turn and scales your Unleash damage.  Upgrade this card as soon as you can.

BODY_SLAM.Commentary: Low output in the early game makes it difficult to take this card - early on, you need better attacks to deal with enemies.  By the time this card is good, you already have a damage plan.  Figuring out the correct time to pivot to this card is key.  With the right build, this is the best damage output for Clad lategame.

BOLAS.Commentary: 3 damage per turn that you only have to draw once.  This just isn't enough damage to be worth buying unless you have Strength or a relic that activates when playing attacks.

BOMBARDMENT.Commentary: Keeps playing itself every turn after you play it once, and looks wicked cool doing it!  Think of this like a 3-cost power.  Excellent find from Attack Potion.

BONE_FLUTE.Commentary: A very steady supply of Block for decks with a decent number of Osty attacks.  Not that good with just Unleash.  Excellent with Right Hand Hand.

BONE_SHARDS.Commentary: Excellent card for the early game as it can solve many encounters on its own.  Worth an early upgrade because both effects scale.

BOOKMARK.Commentary: It can be tricky to make use of the discount from this Relic.  Works best if you have multiple different Retain cards or Poke.

BOOK_OF_FIVE_RINGS.Commentary: The huge heal is very nice, but there's a long wait to get it.  You will have to pick cards carefully in order to time the heals properly.

BOOK_REPAIR_KNIFE.Commentary: A gradual source of healing that can be useful for decks with Doom.  Useless if you don't have Doom cards, plus it can be tricky to land kills in the specified manner.

BOOMING_CONCH.Commentary: A big help in Elite fights through the whole run.  Even better if you can fight 3+ Elites in Act I.

BOOST_AWAY.Commentary: Very nice block output for a 0-cost card.  The daze is a minor inconvenience that you can mitigate with card draw or turn to your advantage with powers like Adaptation or Smokestack.

BOOT_SEQUENCE.Commentary: For when you absolutely, positively have to block on turn 1.  Even better if you have bonus draw at combat start.  Good target for Enchantments since you always get it at the start of fights.

BORROWED_TIME.Commentary: An excellent way to get more energy for your turn.  The increased card costs can allow you to get good value from Danse Macabre.

BOUNCING_FLASK.Commentary: One of the classic poison cards.  Excellent as part of a broader poison strategy, but also good as a one-off in a different kind of deck.  Splashing (heh) this card will make the Entomancer a much easier fight.

BOWLER_HAT.Commentary: More money isn't that useful on its own - you'll only get enough to buy one replacement relic.  Can become useful if combined with other sources of Gold such as Signet Ring.

BRAND.Commentary: A very useful 'bridge' card that works with self-damage, Exhaust, and Strength interactions.  Not particularly strong in isolation, but the strength of this card lies in its ability to stack triggered effects from powers and relics.

BREAD.Commentary: Energy per turn is a huge upside but limiting your turn 1 will hurt in many combats.  May not be worth it unless you have other turn 1 bonuses such as Lantern.

BREAK.Commentary: Simply ludicrous damage for 1 energy.  Get it back with Headbutt to play it more often!

BREAKTHROUGH.Commentary: Passable area damage. Two common cards for Clad that inflict self-damage (this and Blood Wall) point to much easier access to self-damage synergy/builds.  In particular, having a card do 1 damage to self is the most efficient way to activate damage effects on the player.

BRILLIANT_SCARF.Commentary: How good this is depends on how reliably you can trigger the effect.  Decks with bonus card draw or 0-cost cards can make the most of it.

BRIMSTONE.Commentary: The positives WAY outweigh the negatives here.  Though you will take more damage you will also be able to end fights much faster by defeating enemies quickly, saving you HP in the long run.  Combine with multi-hit attacks and big blocks.

BRONZE_SCALES.Commentary: Consistent damage output in any fight that improves against multi-attacking enemies.  Excellent in Act II.

BUBBLE_BUBBLE.Commentary: This is mathematically the most effective poison card, but it can't be your ONLY poison card.  Combine with lots of draw/discard to find your other poison cards first, or just use it with the Twisted Funnel relic.

BUFFER.Commentary: Great for stopping single big hits in a wide variety of fights. This can also block direct HP damage from curse or status cards.

BULK_UP.Commentary: An interesting scaling option that packs more punch than you'd expect.  Many Defect cards scale very well with STR/DEX such as Gunk Shot.  Losing an orb slot isn't much of a downside and can even provide a benefit at times by letting you evoke orbs faster.

BULLET_TIME.Commentary: A powerful energy cheat that lets you throw down an entire hand of expensive cards.  Best results with improved card draw or with Retain.

BULLY.Commentary: Gives Clad a good reason to stack more vulnerable. Even with 1 vulnerable, this card deals 9 for 0 energy which is comparable to Anger. Works very well with Exhaust effects to thin your deck down to just Vulnerable cards and Bully.

BULWARK.Commentary: One of the best forge cards.  Blocking while building up your sword accomplishes two urgent needs at the same time with one card.  Excellent.

BUNDLE_OF_JOY.Commentary: Colorless cards can be quite strong, but it's hard to justify the energy spend on this card most of the time.  Decent with Pillar of Creation.

BURNING_PACT.Commentary: This card 'accelerates' your deck by both removing bad cards as well as drawing new ones to immediately replace the exhausted card.  Combine with energy generation from something like Bloodletting and you can play many more cards per turn.

BURNING_STICKS.Commentary: Most useful for creating an additional copy of powerful single-use cards.  Potential targets include Adrenaline, Offering, Apparition, Discovery, or Abundance.  Be sure to Exhaust your most powerful Skill first.

BURST.Commentary: Broadly applicable skill multiplier that works in a variety of decks. Note that this will also multiply discarded Sly skills like Reflex or Tactician!  A useful tool for infinites.

BURY.Commentary: Very powerful, if tricky to play.  Combine this with effects like Vulnerable or Lethality to multiply the already high damage.

CALAMITY.Commentary: The generated attacks will ALSO create more attacks, so this power lets you keep playing random attacks until you spend all your energy!  Very useful if you happen to have tons of energy lying around.

CALCIFY.Commentary: Strength, but for Osty.  Packs a real punch when combined with Right Hand Hand or Rattle.

CALCULATED_GAMBLE.Commentary: A universally great tool for Silent.  Mulligan an entire hand to try to get block, dig through your deck to find powers, or activate a whole hand of Sly cards.  Even better with discard relics.

CALLING_BELL.Commentary: Three Relics can be very helpful or not helpful at all.  Getting a Curse card alongside make this a bit of a gamble.

CALL_OF_THE_VOID.Commentary: Card draw per turn plus Ethereal synergies is a nice value package.  If it generates a junk card, simply let it Exhaust.  Useful against Doormaker.

CALTROPS.Commentary: A very nice source of passive damage for decks that can block well.  You will still want other sources of damage to use against enemies that don't attack often.

CANDELABRA.Commentary: A big boost of energy that arrives very early in fights.  Great for getting powers in play or bursting enemies down.

CAPACITOR.Commentary: Think of this as a long-term power-up for slow combats.  Generating more orb slots will slow down your evoke benefits but allow you to stack more per-turn benefits.  As such, this is not a card for the early game. Much better with sources of Focus.

CAPTAINS_WHEEL.Commentary: An excellent boost of Block, but the turn 3 timing makes it quite awkward in many fights.

CAPTURE_SPIRIT.Commentary: This is primarily a card draw card.  Most useful for activating Soul synergies or if you need to draw through your deck quickly.

CASCADE.Commentary: Lets you turn energy into immediate card plays.  Better with more energy that you can make and more expensive cards in your deck.  Great upgrade.

CATASTROPHE.Commentary: Both unpredictable and expensive, but it can be worthwhile if you have expensive cards in the deck.  Multiple copies can chain-react for tons of card plays.

CAULDRON.Commentary: Rarely worth it compared to simply buying the other Potions available in this shop.  Occasionally nice if you have a ton of Potion slots.

CELESTIAL_MIGHT.Commentary: Passable damage for 2 energy - this gets a lot better if you have a source of Strength or Vigor to boost the damage.  Decent Act 1 card, especially when facing Vantom.

CENTENNIAL_PUZZLE.Commentary: Powerful card draw that lets you control the timing.  Consider intentionally taking a small amount of damage Turn 1 to get a big draw on Turn 2.

CHANDELIER.Commentary: A huge boost of Energy with awkward timing.  Great if you can Retain multiple cards or otherwise get many cards in hand for turn 3.

CHAOS.Commentary: With 5 orb types to pick from, this card is highly unpredictable.  Works best when you want to have multiple orbs of different types, such as with Compile Driver or Coolant.  Upgrading this card is mandatory to get the most out of it.

CHARGE.Commentary: Think of this as exhausting two targeted cards in your draw pile.  Get rid of curses or statuses, or even thin your deck to go infinite.  Deceptively strong effect.  Minion Dive Bomb is a colorless card.

CHARGE_BATTERY.Commentary: Highly efficient block combined with next-turn energy makes this an excellent pickup in Underdocks Act I or as part of a late-game block engine with Dexterity sources.

CHARONS_ASHES.Commentary: Tons of free damage for decks with many Exhaust cards.  Cards that can Exhaust multiple other cards such as Fiend Fire are most effective.

CHEMICAL_X.Commentary: Powerful in theory but it's hard to find cards that work with this effect.  Most useful if you already have one or two X-cost cards.

CHILD_OF_THE_STARS.Commentary: Block on Regent is hard to come by, and this is one of the best ways to get it.  Lets you block for free while playing your big payoff cards.

CHILL.Commentary: Incredible defensive output for 0 energy, even in fights that have only one foe.  Upgrading this allows you to return it with All for One or Hologram.

CHOICES_PARADOX.Commentary: Often generates an extra Power or Rare card for you to use.  Choosing from 5 means you almost always get something relevant to the current combat.

CINDER.Commentary: Decent damage for a 2-cost attack, plus thinning your deck each time you play it.  Play last on your turn to avoid losing another card you might want to play.

CLASH.Commentary: Very good damage, but the condition to play this can be tricky to meet.  Status and Curse cards will prevent you from using this at all.  Better if you can Exhaust or Discard cards from hand.

CLAW.Commentary: A one-card scaling solution!  Combine with Feral, Hologram, or All For One to play it over and over or just take a bunch of copies!  4 seems to be the magic number of copies that you want - any more and your deck will start to bloat.

CLAWS.Commentary: Upgrades or Enchantments on transformed cards will carry over.  Maul scales damage fairly slowly relative to the energy cost.  Don't expect to beat Bosses without additional damage help.

CLEANSE.Commentary: Use this to thin curses, statuses or basic cards from the draw pile and improve your future draws.

CLOAK_AND_DAGGER.Commentary: A very solid common for silent that lets you dish out some damage while blocking at the same time.  Really wants an upgrade for the extra shiv to be effective at doing damage.

CLOAK_CLASP.Commentary: Free Block is always great!  Gets better if you can draw or Retain more cards.

CLOAK_OF_STARS.Commentary: Very cheap block is much desired on Regent.  Nice to have a copy or two for defense as long as you have stars to spare.

COLD_SNAP.Commentary: Extremely solid early-game attack that gives you immediate damage and gradual block.  Use this as part of a broader strategy to put a lot of orbs in play or as part of an attack-spamming playstyle.

COLLISION_COURSE.Commentary: Very impressive damage for a 0-cost card.  For 1 energy you can play the Debris and negate the downside.  Also works with Pillar of Creation to generate block.

COLOSSUS.Commentary: One of Clad's best damage mitigation cards.  Reduced damage values round down, making this block for more than 50% at times.  Make sure you have multiple ways to apply vulnerable to get most of this card.

COMET.Commentary: Very powerful star payoff card.  Combine with other big attacks to smash your foes!

COMPACT.Commentary: This card provides underwhelming block on its own but becomes crazy effective if you can get Status cards in hand.  Can form an infinite combo with 2x Overclock.

COMPILE_DRIVER.Commentary: One of the best draw cards on the character if you have multiple orbs in your build.  Orb slots allow this to go even harder.

CONFLAGRATION.Commentary: A solid area-damage card that goes hard with Strength.  Also very nice if you can find an Enchantment.

CONQUEROR.Commentary: This provides very little Forge, so you're taking this for the turn of doubled blade damage.  Extremely strong if you can scale the Blade's damage with other cards.  Multiple applications increase the duration of the effect.

CONSUMING_SHADOW.Commentary: Evoking your rear orb every turn is meant to allow you to keep a Dark orb in front that steadily grows in power while you play other orb cards.  You can also use this to simply activate more Evoke effects.  The orb will activate its passive effect on the same turn that it Evokes, so you benefit twice in one turn.

CONVERGENCE.Commentary: A great utility card.  This card is for setting up your combos by getting combo pieces in hand together and giving you the resources to use them.  Combo Falling Star with your other attacks, or create even stronger combos from other cards.

COOLANT.Commentary: A fairly decent source of passive block output for decks that have at least a couple orb types.  There are more exciting Rare cards, but this can get the job done.

COOLHEADED.Commentary: Not a great card for your first few picks but gets a lot better as the game progresses.  Gradual block output and card draw are both more useful in longer combats, making this an excellent part of a late-game build.  The more energy you can generate, the better this is.

COORDINATE.Commentary: Fairly difficult to use since you must draw this on the same turn that the other player gets their damage cards.  More useful with more players.

CORROSIVE_WAVE.Commentary: One of the best cards in the game for Silent as long as you have any amount of card draw.  Acrobatics and Calculated Gamble are the best combos, but keep an eye out for Prepared, Master of Strategy, and Backflips as well.

CORRUPTION.Commentary: Basically makes all your blocks free so you can spend energy on attacks.  You should have a plan to win the fight by the time you run out of block cards.

COSMIC_INDIFFERENCE.Commentary: Very solid early block.  Use to return Sovereign Blade to the top of the draw pile, or any other card you need next turn.  Great with I Am Invincible.

COUNTDOWN.Commentary: A solid source of damage-per-turn for longer fights.  Very nice alongside Sleight of Flesh or Shroud.

CRASH_LANDING.Commentary: Upfront AoE with an unusual downside.  Avoid by playing at the end of the fight or while your hand is full, or benefit from the debris with cards like Pillar of Creation or GUARDS!!!

CREATIVE_AI.Commentary: This card can win any fight.... eventually.  Across enough turns, random powers will slowly but surely increase your output until you overwhelm the boss.  Wants energy-generating support like TURBO or Subroutine and also appreciates having a good block engine.

CRESCENT_SPEAR.Commentary: This is like a worse Perfected Strike.  Subpar damage in the early game, but can scale pretty well with lots of copies or a large deck in general.

CRIMSON_MANTLE.Commentary: Very solid block per turn combined with self-damage to activate other cards.  Nice with Rupture, Tear Asunder or the relic Self-Forming Clay.

CROSSBOW.Commentary: May generate 2- or 3-cost attacks for free, resulting in massive damage output.  Goes especially hard if you have synergies with 0-cost cards or benefit from playing many cards per turn.  The added cards may clog your deck but it's worth it.

CRUELTY.Commentary: Treat this like a multiplier to all of your Attack damage, so it works equally well with large single attacks or multiple small hits.  Gets even better with multiple copies.

CRUSH_UNDER.Commentary: A solid early attack that can be worth upgrading.  Smacking all foes and debuffing their attacks is extremely useful in swarm fights.  Pretty good as your first AoE card.

CURSED_PEARL.Commentary: Despite the curse, this is a ton of buying power that can easily net you two Relics from the first shop.  Great as long as you can get to a Shop early.

DAGGER_SPRAY.Commentary: A solid early common due to the abundance of multi-enemy fights.  Upgrade this quick for the +4 to all.  Extremely good with Akabeko.

DAGGER_THROW.Commentary: A simple and effective damage common that lets you mill a card from the draw pile at worst.  Sets you up to start drafting Sly cards.

DANSE_MACABRE.Commentary: A very nice card that works with Necrobinder's more expensive tools.  Also works extremely well with Borrowed Time and Transfigure.

DARKNESS.Commentary: Very high damage output for 1 energy, but the catch is that you must Evoke the orb for the payoff.  Works extremely well with multiple Evokes from Dualcast, Multicast, or Quadcast.  Remember that Dark always targets the enemy with the least HP.

DARK_EMBRACE.Commentary: Powers that draw more cards are extremely strong because they can get you additional cards across many turns for only a single initial card play.  This card is one of the strongest card draw powers because you can activate the effect many times per turn.  This combos with a wide variety of cards, including some Curse and Status cards.

DARK_SHACKLES.Commentary: A 0-cost card that can singlehandedly stop attacks from endgame bosses.  Consistently useful damage mitigation through the whole game.

DASH.Commentary: A very efficient "value package" - two big numbers on one card.  This allows you to get through the early game while picking other cards for your late-game plan.  Upgrade for best results.

DATA_DISK.Commentary: One of the best relics for Defect, free Focus is always excellent.  Even better with more Orbs!

DEADLY_POISON.Commentary: The quintessential first-floor poison card.  This is better damage than similar attacks as long as the fight lasts for more than 3 turns, which is the case for most boss and elite fights.

DEATHBRINGER.Commentary: 2 cost area damage on a common card is quite noteworthy, and gives Necrobinder a powerful tool for early multi-enemy fights.  The hard part is going to be blocking while all the enemies take their last turn.

DEATHS_DOOR.Commentary: Easily the best block card on the character if you can activate the effect.  Easily activated with the Doom per turn from Neurosurge or Countdown.  A great target for the Nimble enchantment.

DEATH_MARCH.Commentary: Goes extremely hard in small, soul-heavy decks that can cycle frequently.  A little underwhelming otherwise.

DEBILITATE.Commentary: Doubled Weak and Vulnerable means half incoming damage or double outgoing damage respectively.  Extremely good alongside Defy or Putrefy.

DECISIONS_DECISIONS.Commentary: Card multiplication is very strong, but this only works on Skill cards and costs a lot of stars.  Use on Hidden Cache or Royal Gamble for massive star generation or even target another Decisions for a chain effect!

DEFEND_DEFECT.Commentary: You're typically stuck with these for most of your run since Strikes are worse.  Not that bad if they get upgraded by an event.

DEFEND_IRONCLAD.Commentary: Adequate enough block in Act I.  An upgraded Defend can help patch your block up if you can't find proper block cards to add.

DEFEND_NECROBINDER.Commentary: These are useful all game for Necro and are particularly nice if they get upgraded or Enchanted.

DEFEND_REGENT.Commentary: Your basic blocks are useful enough in the early game, and can be relevant all game if upgraded and/or Enchanted.

DEFEND_SILENT.Commentary: Love 'em or hate 'em, but you can't live without 'em.  Silent makes good use of her Defends with Well-Laid Plans and Footwork.  You can also improve these with colorless cards like Fasten.

DEFILE.Commentary: Very efficient damage for the early game allows you to get through difficult encounters without much trouble.

DEFLECT.Commentary: Very good block for any deck with bonus card draw.  A little underwhelming if you're only drawing 5 per turn.

DEFRAGMENT.Commentary: One of the few ways to get Focus for a whole fight.  If you can fill all of your orb slots, you probably want this card.  A must-upgrade.

DEFY.Commentary: Incredible defensive value for a common card.  Weak is very useful, but you sometimes have to play this card for no value to avoid Exhausting it.

DELAY.Commentary: Efficient block plus next-turn energy allows for setting up big turns without losing HP upfront.  Really wants an upgrade.

DELICATE_FROND.Commentary: Not bad with 2 Potion slots, and incredible if you have more than 2.  It can still be worth keeping a really good potion across several fights instead of using it right away.

DEMESNE.Commentary: An excellent way to scale up your output in longer fights, even if the upfront cost is high.

DEMONIC_SHIELD.Commentary: Useful both as a way to help your allies block and as a way to activate self-damage effects for only 1 hp loss.  You'll want other good block cards so that your friend can benefit.

DEMON_FORM.Commentary: Often feels far too slow for 3 energy, given the overall scarcity of energy and lack of cheap multi-hit cards for Ironclad.  There are other ways to get Strength for cheaper, but this card is still excellent if you can get it into play for free.

DEMON_TONGUE.Commentary: This works with effects that damage you at the end of your turn, such as Curse and Status cards or debuff effects from enemies.  Cards like Offering are excellent as well!

DEVASTATE.Commentary: Huge damage to cost ratio, but this is slightly too expensive to play from the opening hand.  Excellent if you have star generators.  Massive upgrade.

DEVOUR_LIFE.Commentary: Spamming Souls becomes a win-condition with this card, as you'll both grow Osty and frequently draw Unleash.

DIAMOND_DIADEM.Commentary: Incredible defense, but blocking alone cannot save you from Boss enemies.  Make sure you have Powers to grow in output while leaning on your defense.

DINGY_RUG.Commentary: Colorless cards appear in rewards only rarely if you have this, and they are not guaranteed to be useful for you even if you do find them.  Look for other options to spend your money.

DIRGE.Commentary: An incredible use for lots of mana on Necrobinder.  Especially busted alongside Borrowed Time.

DISCOVERY.Commentary: A very useful card that can help in a wide variety of situations thanks to the three options.  The upgraded version can be a scaling method since it can repeatedly generate powers.

DISMANTLE.Commentary: Excellent pickup in the early game when you can count on Bash to provide vulnerable.  Later in the game, you are likely to need more support to keep this card useful.

DISTINGUISHED_CAPE.Commentary: Apparitions are excellent damage mitigation and the price to acquire them is not that big compared to the benefit.  Best in decks with a solid damage output plan already in place.

DISTRACTION.Commentary: Very unreliable, but at least it almost always does something useful.  Decent with an upgrade.

DODGE_AND_ROLL.Commentary: Both instances of block will benefit from your Dexterity giving this card double scaling.  Good upgrade or enchantment target as well.

DOLLYS_MIRROR.Commentary: Only as good as your best card.  Totally worth it for duplicating Upgraded, Enchanted, or Ancient cards.

DOMINATE.Commentary: One of the best ways to get Strength on Ironclad.  Always provides a small amount but goes crazy with cards like Tremble and Molten Fist.  Beware of enemies with Artifact!

DOUBLE_ENERGY.Commentary: On its own this is outclassed by most of Defect's other energy-generating cards, but it can combine with them for incredible output.  Amazing if you have Ice Cream or any X-cost card.

DRAGON_FRUIT.Commentary: Adds up to a surprising amount of Max HP over the course of a run.  Gets even better if you have an additional source of Gold such as Lucky Fysh or Amethyst Aubergine.

DRAIN_POWER.Commentary: Nice scaling for longer fights.  Gradually upgrades all of your cards allowing for more effective output.

DRAMATIC_ENTRANCE.Commentary: No-nonsense turn 1 damage helps in a lot of shorter combats.  Very nice if you have Bag of Marbles for turn 1 Vulnerable.

DREDGE.Commentary: Fetching 3 cards at once allows you to get big cards + energy generation or any other useful combo from the discard pile.  Upgrading for retain makes for even better timing.

DRIFTWOOD.Commentary: Lets you look at more cards if the first offering isn't good enough to take.  Can be used to find specific synergies or hunt for upgraded cards.  Offers no immediate benefit for the start of Act II, so you may want to look elsewhere.

DRUM_OF_BATTLE.Commentary: Not very useful if you play it for the draw.  The main benefit is acting as 'fuel' for cards like Second Wind or True Grit and giving you energy back.  Great with Corruption.

DUALCAST.Commentary: A useful way to multiply orb output all game long.  Especially nice on Dark or Glass orbs.

DUAL_WIELD.Commentary: Most useful for duplicating power cards or 0-cost Attacks.  Any temporary cost reduction on the copied card will apply to the copies as well, making this card excellent with Attack or Power potions.

DUSTY_TOME.Commentary: Depends on how good the card fits into your deck.

DYING_STAR.Commentary: Another great star payoff, this can negate an entire enemy turn with the strength down effect.  Especially excellent in multiplayer.

ECHOING_SLASH.Commentary: Try to set this up so that the first hit kills one enemy and the second hit kills another.  Very useful against enemies that summon low-health minions, so this is a decent take leading into Act 3.

ECHO_FORM.Commentary: One of the strongest ways for Defect to scale.  Better with lots of 2 or 3 cost cards, not so much with 0-cost cards.  If this is your first card of the turn and you duplicate it with Duplicator, Signal Boost or another Echo Form you can start using the effect immediately.

ECTOPLASM.Commentary: Energy that comes with a price.  Nice if you already have a large pile of Gold or if the additional Energy is worth losing out on future Relics.

EIDOLON.Commentary: Don't worry too much about the Intangible - the main benefit of this card is Exhausting your hand.  Deleting less-useful cards will let you draw what's left of your deck much more quickly.

ELECTRIC_SHRYMP.Commentary: Excellent with 2- or 3-cost Skill cards like End of Days or Reanimate.  Beware falling behind in longer combats compared to Relics that give per-turn effects.

EMOTION_CHIP.Commentary: A huge increase in your Orb output if you are taking damage.  Consider underblocking by 1 or 2 on some turns to get a bonus on the next turn.

EMPTY_CAGE.Commentary: Removing 2 Starter or Curse cards will give your deck a solid improvement in consistency and speed.  This effect isn't all that powerful, so consider other options too.

END_OF_DAYS.Commentary: Excellent either on its own or as part of a broader Doom deck.  Great at instantly ending multi-enemy fights.

ENERGY_SURGE.Commentary: Yes, that means you too!  Extremely good value with 3 or 4 players.

ENFEEBLING_TOUCH.Commentary: Absolutely ludicrous damage reduction for 1 energy against a myriad of opponents and bosses.  Be prepared to play this for no value just to keep it around.

ENTRENCH.Commentary: Combines with Barricade to form a game-winning strategy.  Can also be used on its own in decks with good card draw or with Body Slam.

ENTROPY.Commentary: Lets you simultaneously look at a new card while getting rid of something you don't plan to play.  Beware: Transforming a curse or status card will give you another card of the same type.

ENVENOM.Commentary: Quite expensive for the amount of Poison provided in most decks.  Can shine with multi-hit cards like Flechettes or with Shivs.

EQUILIBRIUM.Commentary: Retaining your hand is appreciated by a wide variety of builds, and you don't feel like you're wasting energy because of the dense block.  You can replay the card to retain your hand for additional turns.

ERADICATE.Commentary: Huge damage on Retain for ending an encounter.  Excellent target for Enchantments.  Great with energy from Borrowed Time.

ESCAPE_PLAN.Commentary: Most Silent decks are skill-heavy which makes this an easy take for good chances of free block.  Good with the powers After Image or Speedster.

ETERNAL_ARMOR.Commentary: The added plating is nice supplemental block, but the high energy cost makes this power hard to easily get in play.  Losing 1 plating per turn will hurt in longer boss fights.

ETERNAL_FEATHER.Commentary: A great source of consistent healing even with a small deck of cards.  Adds a lot of value to Rest Sites.

EVIL_EYE.Commentary: Decent block if you can't activate the effect, and ludicrous block if you can!  Worth grabbing early on even if you can't yet meet the condition consistently because of how strong this card can be.

EXPECT_A_FIGHT.Commentary: Extremely powerful with card draw effects, especially Aggression or Pillage.  Get a bunch of attacks in hand, then play this and dump them all!  Also works nice with Thrumming Hatchet from the colorless pool.

EXPERTISE.Commentary: A very strong card draw option in decks that can spend a lot of energy.  Gets worse if you're retaining cards and better if you can discard.

EXPOSE.Commentary: A very takeable physical damage amplifier that benefits any attack-centric deck.  Removing all Artifact is particularly useful in Multiplayer games.

FALLING_STAR.Commentary: This is your most impactful starting card.  The debuffs are useful all game long, but you might find that Stars are better spent on other cards.

FAN_OF_KNIVES.Commentary: Only good if you have other Shiv cards or synergies.  Not worth playing in every combat.  Fun interaction with Envenom.

FASTEN.Commentary: If you still have all your starting blocks this can be an excellent source of block.  Works on Ultimate Defend too.

FEAR.Commentary: Doesn't give enough Vulnerable to feel worthwhile without an upgrade.  Quite nice with Debilitate.

FEED.Commentary: A steady source of Max HP, but it can be tricky to land consistently.  Extremely good with Retain, or with cards that can make additional copies.  Don't upgrade this card.

FEEL_NO_PAIN.Commentary: This becomes a great card once you have 3 or 4 sources of Exhaust in your deck.  Particularly busted with Stoke or Fiend Fire.

FENCING_MANUAL.Commentary: A solid boost to decks using Forge to scale.  Decks not using Forge cards will rarely play the sword outside of Act I.

FERAL.Commentary: A huge enabler for 0-cost attack spam.  Great with Claw, Beam Cell, Go for the Eyes, Tesla Coil and more.  0-cost attacks will return to your hand with this even if Exhausted.  For best results, use Hologram and/or All for One to make sure you can play an eligible attack every turn.

FESTIVE_POPPER.Commentary: A nice headstart on damaging various enemies.  Most useful in Act I and Act II where the enemy health is quite low.

FETCH.Commentary: A free 'cantrip'-style card that won't do much unless you have bonuses like Calcify or an attack relic.  Nice for stacking the damage of Squeeze.

FIDDLE.Commentary: Extremely good for decks without mid-turn draw effects, extremely limiting for ones that already have lots of draw.   You can still benefit start-of-turn draw effects.

FIEND_FIRE.Commentary: Dealing a lot of damage is the obvious benefit of this card, but exhausting your whole hand is also beneficial.  Play any cards you don't want to Exhaust first, THEN play the Fiend Fire to delete everything else.  This can let you thin your deck down to one strong combo.

FIGHT_ME.Commentary: Fight me, Tanx!! This card is a very powerful source of Strength gain, and the drawback is minimal against most opponents.  Be careful playing this on enemies with multihit moves, especially in multiplayer.

FIGHT_THROUGH.Commentary: Very powerful block, but clunky if you can't benefit from the status cards.  Combine with Adaptation and/or Compact to get a superb block engine.

FINESSE.Commentary: A little bit of extra block never hurts.  This card is much more valuable if it comes upgraded already or if you have Dexterity.

FINISHER.Commentary: Potentially massive damage if you spam a lot of attacks, but this can also do nothing if you draw all skills.  Best with Shivs or Retain.

FISHING_ROD.Commentary: The bonus across the whole run is significant, but this boon takes a long time to pay off.  Random upgrades are also unreliable.

FISTICUFFS.Commentary: A very efficient card that benefits massively from damage boosts.  Both Strength and Dexterity affect the block from this card.

FLAK_CANNON.Commentary: The ultimate payoff for a status-generating build.  You can play any number of status-generating cards and not worry about drawing them as long as you play this before reshuffling the deck.  Especially good with Strength to boost the damage.

FLAME_BARRIER.Commentary: A surprisingly effective package of solid block + reflected damage.  Doesn't really fit into a 'build', but is a versatile tool that can contribute in a wide range of situations.

FLANKING.Commentary: Let your friends hit for massive damage! Multiple applications further increase the damage multiplier.

FLASH_OF_STEEL.Commentary: A reasonable 'free' damage add that works a lot better if you have Strength or improved physical damage.  A nice combo piece for creating infinites.

FLATTEN.Commentary: Poke's bigger brother.  Activating the effect can be a little tricky but if you can do it reliably then this card will carry your damage.

FLECHETTES.Commentary: One of the strongest attacks in the class. Scale the damage with card draw or Retain effects to get more cards in hand.

FLICK_FLACK.Commentary: Below the power curve if you pay energy to play this, but becomes excellent value if discard is online.  A nice common to help with early encounters.

FOCUSED_STRIKE.Commentary: A simple damage-dealer you can take in the early game that also benefits your orbs.  You'll want to upgrade this to get the most out of the effect.  Very good at helping Frost to make block.

FOLLOW_THROUGH.Commentary: Fairly solid damage if the effect can be activated.  Get more cards in hand with draw effects, retain effects, or your starting relic!

FOOTWORK.Commentary: Most runs will want at least one copy of this.  One of the best ways to scale your defense up for later acts.

FORBIDDEN_GRIMOIRE.Commentary: Slow but steady deck thinning for the rest of your run.   Use this to create a polished, thin deck with only upgraded cards.

FOREGONE_CONCLUSION.Commentary: A very useful rare for setting up strong combo turns by getting your key cards all in hand together.  Well worth an upgrade.

FORGOTTEN_RITUAL.Commentary: A solid one-time energy boost that fits into Exhaust synergy decks.  Great with Dark Embrace or Burning Pact.

FRIENDSHIP.Commentary: One of the best ways for Necrobinder to get more energy.  Osty is not affected by negative strength, so your Osty attacks are not penalized.

FROZEN_EGG.Commentary: Power cards are highly desirable and usually have very good upgrades, making this an excellent pickup.  Use your Rest Sites to upgrade Skills or for healing instead.

FTL.Commentary: A simple 'free' damage card you can add to get some bonus attack output in almost any deck.  Very helpful for activating attack relics like Shuriken, Kunai, or Kusarigama.

FUNERARY_MASK.Commentary: Effectively draw 3 per fight, plus any synergies you may have with Soul cards.

FURNACE.Commentary: Steady damage scaling for boss fights condensed into one card.  Won't be that good unless you have other support cards for Sovereign Blade.

FUR_COAT.Commentary: There's no way to guarantee that the 1 HP enemies will be on the same map path.  Might get you a free Elite or two, but you'll still have to fight the Boss.

FUSION.Commentary: Trade short-term energy for gradual energy per turn.  Alternately, Dualcast the plasma for an immediate spike of energy.  Very good with Compile Driver.

GALACTIC_DUST.Commentary: Great source of added Block for decks that are spending Stars consistently.  Can be set up to provide Block for your first Stars spent in combat.

GAMBLING_CHIP.Commentary: Allows you to customize your opening hand so that turn 1 is never a bad turn.  Becomes ridiculously good if you have additional draw on turn 1.

GAME_PIECE.Commentary: Mitigates the usual downside of Power cards by allowing them to replace themselves in your hand immediately.  Allows you to add way more Powers to your deck, especially if they are 0-cost.

GAMMA_BLAST.Commentary: A strong and effective Star spender for getting longer-lasting debuffs.  You'll need decent Star generation to be able to play this more than once.

GANG_UP.Commentary: This is lots of damage most of the time even in a 2-player game.  Be sure to coordinate with your allies to get the most out of this.

GATHER_LIGHT.Commentary: Decent enough block, but doesn't get you much in the way of stars.  Good enough if you need both things.

GENESIS.Commentary: Kind of expensive for what it does, as Regent does not often have the defensive tools to stick around long enough to get stars from this.  Best with star-costed block cards like Cloak of Stars and Particle Wall.

GENETIC_ALGORITHM.Commentary: Starts out useless, but quickly turns into a card that makes you invincible for 1 turn.  Worth taking as late as the end of Act II.

GHOST_SEED.Commentary: Effectively removes every Strike and Defend after a single draw of your deck.  Obscenely good for longer combats against Bosses or for any deck with good card draw.

GIRYA.Commentary: The ability to get permanent Strength is quite nice, but having to use your Rest Site action to get it is a big tradeoff.  Really good if you have the Miniature Tent.

GLACIER.Commentary: Defect's ultimate block card.  Any deck can appreciate this but it works especially well with Focus or other orb synergies.

GLASSWORK.Commentary: The combination of block plus area damage makes this an excellent Act I + II card.  Glass benefits especially well from Focus and orb generation, so the more of each that you have the better.

GLASS_EYE.Commentary: A one-time flood of cards can help fill out synergies or assemble combos but may not offer you cards that you actually want.

GLIMMER.Commentary: Card draw combined with manipulation for your next turn.  Very useful for getting Star cards to line up with resource generation, or for setting up combo cards.

GLIMPSE_BEYOND.Commentary: Other classes can make good use of Souls, so everyone will appreciate this contribution to their draw pile.

GLITTER.Commentary: Even bad Common cards are very strong if you play them twice!  You'll want to add lots of cards to the deck if you take this, so pick a path with a lot of combats.

GLITTERSTREAM.Commentary: Solid 2-cost block that is mostly frontloaded.  Very good total block relative to its cost.  This card is especially strong if the effect is multiplied by things like Pael's Legion or the Vambrace.

GLOW.Commentary: Very good resource scaling card with a solid upgrade.  Use this to both find your star spenders and allow you to afford them.

GNARLED_HAMMER.Commentary: A solid improvement to your 3 best damage cards.  Works best on cards that hit ALL enemies or hit multiple times.

GOLDEN_COMPASS.Commentary: Creates an extra-long Act II with a bonus Relic chest, 4 Rest Sites and 2 Elite combats.  How good this is will depend on the path options in your current Act II map which you can look at right now.

GOLDEN_PEARL.Commentary: Makes an early shop very good!  Enough cash to get a Relic and a Potion.

GOLD_AXE.Commentary: For most decks the damage will only increase by 3 or 4 per turn, but this can really pop off if you are generating lots of cards or if you have a lot of 0-cost cards.

GOLD_PLATED_CABLES.Commentary: It's like having an extra filled orb slot!  Guaranteed value every turn.

GORGET.Commentary: Gives 10 total block across your first 4 Turns, which consistently saves HP.  Even better if you can stack additional sources of Plating on top of this.

GO_FOR_THE_EYES.Commentary: A very takeable Weak card that can be replayed with Hologram, Feral, or All for One.  Equally good in Act I and Act III.  Likes an upgrade.

GRAND_FINALE.Commentary: Very tricky to play without both Retain and a solid draw engine.  If you happen to have both, take this card and go crazy!

GRAVEBLAST.Commentary: Not much damage for 1 energy but can fetch useful cards like Unleash from the discard.  Mostly outclassed by Dredge.

GRAVE_WARDEN.Commentary: A very solid early block that works great with Soul synergies.

GREMLIN_HORN.Commentary: A big boost in your output for fights involving numerous small enemies.  Can be used to make up for a lack of AoE cards.

GUARDS.Commentary: Absolutely insane utility by allowing you to both block for a bunch as well as effectively exhaust any number of cards in your hand.  Use this to banish status/curse cards or to thin out weaker cards from your deck to set up a combo.

GUIDING_STAR.Commentary: Great card draw attached to a decent attack.  Star cost has to be managed but can be well worth it.

GUNK_UP.Commentary: Great damage output to help you through Act I and can enable status synergies later.  The damage improves substantially with Strength or Enchantments.

HAILSTORM.Commentary: Consistent if underwhelming damage when you've got Frost in the deck.  Won't cut it as your only damage source but can be a pretty good supplement for a defensive deck.

HAMMER_TIME.Commentary: Everybody gets a sword!  How useful this is depends on whether your allies can use physical attacks well and how much you can Forge.  Most importantly, it looks very cool.

HAND_OF_GREED.Commentary: A solid source of physical damage in addition to the gold gain.  Since it doesn't Exhaust, you can use this card repeatedly.  Will easily pay for itself if purchased in Act I.

HAND_TRICK.Commentary: Immediate block plus the ability to make any skill playable for free.  Good targets include Snakebite, Leg Sweep, and Nightmare.

HANG.Commentary: Useful as a win condition for longer fights.  Stack the damage quickly by replaying this card with Graveblast or Dredge.

HAPPY_FLOWER.Commentary: Additional Energy is almost always great.  End fights with the counter on 2 to get Turn 1 energy in the next fight.

HAUNT.Commentary: Massive damage if you're able to generate a lot of Souls from a card like Severance or Capture Spirit.

HAVOC.Commentary: This card is a lot more desirable if you can upgrade it.  Combo with Headbutt to play a particular card, or just use it to remove cards from the draw pile.  Doesn't add much value to the starting deck, making this a bad floor 1 pick.

HAZE.Commentary: Far too expensive to pay energy for but is a nice supplemental poison source with Sly.  You will want other sources of Poison in addition to this.

HEADBUTT.Commentary: Deceptively useful damage common.  Put your best damage card back on top of the deck to use it again, set up a crucial block for an incoming attack, or fetch a Power card that you had to skip playing earlier.

HEAVENLY_DRILL.Commentary: Extremely fun card.  Stack energy gain effects, then one-shot your foes!  Muahahaha!

HEFTY_TABLET.Commentary: Many Rare cards are dead weight at the start of the run, so this can be a big gamble.  You'll need a particularly good Rare to make up for the Curse.

HEGEMONY.Commentary: The damage offered by this card is somewhat low, meaning you need to take advantage of the bonus energy on the next turn.  Combos very well with card draw or X-cost cards like Heavenly Drill.  Becomes energy-positive with Orbit.

HEIRLOOM_HAMMER.Commentary: Subpar damage means you need to utilize the duplication effect to get the most of this card.  Use it on the Sovereign Blade or with any other generated colorless card.

HELICAL_DART.Commentary: A great defensive boost if your deck is able to play multiple Shivs per turn.  If you're not running Shivs specifically, this will be useless.

HELIX_DRILL.Commentary: Deals 9 damage with your base 3 energy which is only passable.  Can get crazy with energy generation and/or All for One.  This is a multi-hit move.

HELLO_WORLD.Commentary: A random Common each turn is fairly useful in the early game, consistently creating block or damage each turn for you to use.  Think of this as draw 1 per turn.

HELLRAISER.Commentary: Lets you play all your Strike cards for 'free' at the cost of them being randomly targeted.  If you don't combine this with card draw, you're likely to end turns with unspent energy.  Excellent with multiple copies of Pommel Strike.

HEMOKINESIS.Commentary: Very efficient damage, especially in the early game.  Although it costs health to use, killing enemies faster can save you health in the long run.  Combo with Rupture or Tear Asunder for added value.

HIDDEN_CACHE.Commentary: Best star generation card in the common pool.  Tons of value for one card.

HIDDEN_DAGGERS.Commentary: Shivs at 0 cost is very useful and gets even better if you have Sly targets to discard.  Also excellent with Unceasing Top.

HIDDEN_GEM.Commentary: Adding Replay to even basic cards allows you to get tons of output for low cost.  This works best in a very small deck, where you are able to repeatedly draw cards with Replay.

HIGH_FIVE.Commentary: Solid area damage makes for a good early-game pick.  Later on, it may be hard to justify the energy cost to get Vulnerable.

HOLOGRAM.Commentary: Being able to fetch any card from your discard pile allows your deck to have great flexibility.  Ideal targets are 0-cost cards or upgraded cards.

HORN_CLEAT.Commentary: Most enemies will attack on turn 2, meaning the block from this is almost always useful.  Very good value for 1 relic.

HOTFIX.Commentary: Improved orb output which is particularly useful for Frost and Glass.  This card really wants an upgrade to make it replayable with Hologram or All for One.

HOWL_FROM_BEYOND.Commentary: An Attack card that can be played directly or exhausted by other cards to get a more powerful effect.  A good payoff for having access to lots of exhaust. Kind of awkward since this card will go to the discard pile after playing from the Exhaust pile.

HUDDLE_UP.Commentary: All your friends will appreciate bonus card draw, and you will too!  A must-upgrade for games with 3 or more players.

HYPERBEAM.Commentary: This will effectively make all your orbs worthless for the rest of the fight, so use wisely.  Most effective when used as a finishing blow to end combat, or you can use it with Plasma which are not penalized by negative Focus.

ICE_CREAM.Commentary: Allows you to easily draft cards that are very expensive as well as cards that generate energy.  If you have this, consider skipping Attack cards on your turn to have more Energy to spend later.

ICE_LANCE.Commentary: Worth picking up if you see it in Act I.  The cost is high, but the combined block and damage output will carry you through most turns.  In late game you'll want energy generation to play alongside this.

IGNITION.Commentary: Non-Defect friends essentially get 1 energy per turn.  A nice helping hand for longer combats.

IMPATIENCE.Commentary: For most decks it is quite hard to empty your hand of attacks and still have energy for other cards.  Very strong in skill-heavy builds.

IMPERVIOUS.Commentary: The gold standard for block cards.  Play it to block a whole turn on its own, but it works even better with Barricade.

INFERNAL_BLADE.Commentary: Frequently generates huge value by creating a 2- or 3-cost attack but may also lowroll into Whirlwind or Anger.  Much nicer with an upgrade to 0-cost.

INFERNO.Commentary: Consistent area damage is a nice effect in many fights.  The main downside is that there is no effect until next turn unless you have other self-damage cards.

INFINITE_BLADES.Commentary: Slow and steady shiv creation is useful in very long combats but too slow for most non-boss fights.  Decent with Phantom Blades.

INFLAME.Commentary: The quintessential 'scaling' card.  One copy gives you enough damage for the first Act and part of Act II, but won't be enough for the endgame.  Multiple copies can work, but there are easier ways to gain large amounts of Strength.  A decent early-mid game pickup.

INTERCEPT.Commentary: Redirecting damage from another player means double damage to you.  You must have additional block cards to play alongside this or you will be overwhelmed.

INTIMIDATING_HELMET.Commentary: Makes playing expensive cards much easier by allowing them to double as Block cards.  Cards that are auto-played such as by Mayhem will still trigger the effect.

INVOKE.Commentary: A very useful way to get more energy.  Especially helpful for playing expensive cards like Reap.

IRON_CLUB.Commentary: Generally draws 1 card per turn, but this can be a lot more if your deck can spam cards.  Most decks will appreciate the added draw.

IRON_WAVE.Commentary: A pretty good 'value package' card that combines two small effects to give you good value for 1 energy.  Benefits from both Strength to improve damage and Dexterity to improve block.  A decent way to incorporate block into an attack-spamming deck.

ITERATION.Commentary: A major enabler for status builds.  Your status cards will become draw-positive allowing you to play cards like Fight Through, Gunk Up or Boost Away without worrying about clogging the deck.

IVORY_TILE.Commentary: Great with some of Necrobinder's expensive cards.  The extra energy allows you to sneak a Block or Power in after playing something huge.

I_AM_INVINCIBLE.Commentary: Solid 1-energy block with a fun added effect.  Combine with Photon Cut, Glimmer, or Cosmic Indifference to guarantee it on top of the draw pile.

JACKPOT.Commentary: The utility of this card definitely varies by character.  Very strong on Defect and Necrobinder, worst on Regent unless you have Stars to spend.

JACK_OF_ALL_TRADES.Commentary: The unpredictability of this card limits it somewhat.  You will need energy available to spend on the created cards.

JEWELED_MASK.Commentary: Starting with a Power card in play can make fights progress so much more smoothly.  Best with a limited set of powers so that you know what you're going to get.

JEWELRY_BOX.Commentary: Upgrading everything improves your block, your damage, and your energy/draw.  Only bad if your deck is already mostly upgraded.

JOSS_PAPER.Commentary: While card draw is useful, this relic activates less than once per fight for most decks.  Can be solid for Ironclad with Exhaust or Shiv Silent.

JUGGERNAUT.Commentary: The damage from this power adds up very fast, especially in a deck that blocks many times for small amounts.  Activates once per card exhausted by Second Wind.  Also great with any relic that gives block like Cloak Clasp or Gorget.

JUGGLING.Commentary: Very nice way to get additional copies of key attacks.  This will also create copies of cards that Exhaust or cards with Enchantments.

JUZU_BRACELET.Commentary: This can let you farm events without worrying about combats, but the occasional combat could be a good thing.  You'd rather have almost any other relic than this.

KALEIDOSCOPE.Commentary: Lets you look at 6 cards before your first fight, which gets you a significant head start.  It's okay to skip one of the two card rewards.

KIFUDA.Commentary: An extremely exploitable relic.  The block amount is improved by Dexterity and can be boosted to ridiculous amounts.  Enchant 0-cost cards or cards that you can return to your hand to maximize the amount of Block gained.

KINGLY_KICK.Commentary: Very substantial upfront damage makes this worth paying 3 energy for when you first draw it.  Combine with Photon Cut, Glimmer, or Cosmic Indifference to re-draw it with an increased discount.

KINGLY_PUNCH.Commentary: Solid scaling damage in a deck that can reshuffle often in combats. Combine with Photon Cut, Glimmer, or Cosmic Indifference to re-draw it with an additional damage boost.

KNIFE_TRAP.Commentary: Powerful payoff card for a Shiv deck, but useless without Shiv sources.  Generates tons of block with After Image.

KNOCKDOWN.Commentary: While this card is very expensive, the damage multiplication can allow your allies to down powerful foes extremely quickly.   Upgrade for maximum effect!

KNOCKOUT_BLOW.Commentary: Huge damage paired with crazy star generation.  Kind of like a superpowered Sunder.

KNOW_THY_PLACE.Commentary: Very spammable skill that scales well into the endgame.  The upgraded version is useful for maintaining consistent draws with Pale Blue Dot or for just generally multiplying your output.  Redundant if you are spending Stars on weak/vuln.

KUNAI.Commentary: An excellent way to improve your deck's defense if you're Attack-heavy.  Works best with 0-cost Attacks or additional Energy.

KUSARIGAMA.Commentary: A nice damage boost for decks that are able to play 3 attacks frequently.  Consider picking up 0-cost attacks more if you have this.

LANTERN.Commentary: Turn 1 is the most important turn, so it's the best turn to get more energy.  Very good if combined with Bag of Preparation.

LARGESSE.Commentary: Surprise your friends with an unexpected gift!  Whether or not they play it is up to them.  No re-gifting.

LARGE_CAPSULE.Commentary: Potentially a large boost of power for the early game, but you will suffer if the Relics aren't immediately useful.

LASTING_CANDY.Commentary: Seeing more Powers allows you to reliably build a deck for the late game.  Try to set this up to activate on Boss battles for a guaranteed rare Power.

LAVA_LAMP.Commentary: The promise of Upgraded cards is alluring but the condition is deceptively difficult to achieve.  Only worth it if your deck has very consistent Block generation or can kill enemies on turn 1.

LAVA_ROCK.Commentary: A good but very delayed bonus.  Worth it if you can take a safer path in Act I with more Rest Sites and fewer Elites.

LEADING_STRIKE.Commentary: A solid reusable Shiv source that is great for activating Attack relics like Nunchaku or Kusarigama.

LEAD_PAPERWEIGHT.Commentary: Colorless cards are very good on average and there are relatively few complete whiffs for Act I.  A useful way to get an initial Power card.

LEAFY_POULTICE.Commentary: Despite the Max HP loss, transforming two starter cards is almost always worth it.  Good chance to get a Rare card.

LEAP.Commentary: Yup, it's block.  A solid pickup in Act I Underdocks, or in the mid/late game when you're lacking solid block output.

LEES_WAFFLE.Commentary: Potentially a livesaver if you're low on HP, but not worth the money for the Max HP alone.  You'll know if you need this.

LEGION_OF_BONE.Commentary: Think of this like giving the other players 6 retaining block.  Non-Necrobinder players can't use Osty except as a shield, but he sure looks cool!

LEG_SWEEP.Commentary: The gold standard of Silent blocks.  Worth investing an upgrade into.

LETHALITY.Commentary: Powerful attack scaling that goes best with Necro's big attacks like Reap, Bury or Banshee's Cry.  Multiple copies will further increase the damage of the first attack.

LETTER_OPENER.Commentary: A huge boost of damage for Skill-heavy decks.  Spamming blocks is a lot more practical if you have this.

LIFT.Commentary: A very efficient block for your chosen recipient.  Better with more players.

LIGHTNING_ROD.Commentary: This is more of a damage card than a block card.  Playing more copies will stack the duration of the effect, leading to diminishing returns.

LIZARD_TAIL.Commentary: Can save your life in a tough spot, but often you'd rather have a different Relic.  Don't forget that you have this!

LOOMING_FRUIT.Commentary: Enough HP to survive a bad Elite combat and still bounce back.  Not the most exciting option but can still be worth it if your Max HP was lowered earlier.

LOOP.Commentary: Activating your orbs additional times has some nice benefits, but there are downsides.  This won't take effect until next turn and can't benefit from temporary focus since it happens at the start of turn, which means this card is fairly weak in the early game.  Most useful when boosting a Dark orb.

LORDS_PARASOL.Commentary: While you do get a bunch of mediocre cards from every shop, the benefits outweigh the downsides.  Totally worth it if you can go to two Shops.

LOST_COFFER.Commentary: Nothing special, but perfectly effective.  Gives you a nice advantage going into your initial combats to save health and guarantees a Potion for the first Elite.

LUCKY_FYSH.Commentary: The Gold from this relic adds up surprisingly quickly.  Look for Ancient rewards that give you more cards.  You also get money for Transformed cards.

LUNAR_BLAST.Commentary: Another multi-hit card that can work as a payoff for Vigor or Strength sources.  Works especially well with a spammable skill like Particle Wall or with colorless card generation.

LUNAR_PASTRY.Commentary: Extra Stars are extremely useful as long as you have a way to spend them.  This will also activate Black Hole every turn.

MACHINE_LEARNING.Commentary: 1 draw per turn provides great consistency in drawing blocks or can help you play more of your 0-cost cards.  Upgrade to innate to get it online faster in long fights.

MAKE_IT_SO.Commentary: The effect on this card will fetch it from the draw or even exhaust pile.   Very spammable attack in a deck with sufficient skills.

MALAISE.Commentary: Extremely useful for slowing down bosses or dangerous elite enemies.  Best with energy generation or Chemical X.

MANGLE.Commentary: Huge damage reduction paired with subpar damage makes for an unusual card.  Hard to justify 3 energy for this unless it completely negates an enemy attack.  Notably does not exhaust.  Very broken if you can make this card free.

MANGO.Commentary: A significant boost to Max HP to give you more durability.  Not as useful as some other Rare Relics but never a bad find.

MANIFEST_AUTHORITY.Commentary: Similar to Shrug it Off as a block and draw 1.  Combos with card generation and colorless card effects.  Upgrading the created card is a nice effect.

MASSIVE_SCROLL.Commentary: Big 'fun' factor on this one.  An early Multiplayer card can help you and your friends pick a direction to build in.

MASTER_OF_STRATEGY.Commentary: Free upfront draw is great in any deck.  The only downside to this one is the price of acquisition.

MASTER_PLANNER.Commentary: Very powerful source of scaling in discards decks that only applies once you've played all your cards once.  A bit slow to get going.  Can be used to create infinite combos.

MAYHEM.Commentary: A free card play each turn can be useful but beware potential side-effects from playing certain cards at the start of your turn.  Attacks will get randomly targeted.

MEAL_TICKET.Commentary: A solid and reliable heal that can be difficult to use depending on map generation.  Very good if you have lots of Gold since you'll want to go to shops anyway.

MEAT_CLEAVER.Commentary: Removing 2 cards at each Rest Site will let you quickly clear the deck of starter cards and other chaff.  Decks that reward re-drawing quickly or decks that can assemble an infinite combo will do best here.

MEAT_ON_THE_BONE.Commentary: A great source of healing to keep you alive through repeated combats.  If you're just above half HP, consider intentionally taking a small amount of damage to activate the heal.

MELANCHOLY.Commentary: 'Anyone' includes Osty, enemies, and your friends in Multiplayer.   Works nice with Bone Shards to kill Osty on your turn.

MEMBERSHIP_CARD.Commentary: It's free money!  The real question is can you afford to NOT buy this?

MEMENTO_MORI.Commentary: Decent attack that benefits from draw/discard effects.  Works early on and gets better as you add more skills.

MERCURY_HOURGLASS.Commentary: More damage is always good, even if it's not very much damage.

METEOR_SHOWER.Commentary: An awesomely powerful upgrade to the starting card that gives both area damage and longer debuffs.  Extremely helpful for the many multi-enemy fights in Act 2.

METEOR_STRIKE.Commentary: Extremely powerful card if you can play it.  Look for ways to discount this card (Confusion, Enlightenment) or try to play energy-generating cards to enable it.

METRONOME.Commentary: Surprisingly easy to trigger if your deck has a decent number of Orb cards.  The damage burst can really help with multi-enemy fights.

MIMIC.Commentary: Only good if your friends are good at blocking.  Better with more players.

MIND_BLAST.Commentary: There are a few ways to get a large number of cards into your deck and turn this into a massive attack.  Particularly effective with certain Daily modifiers.

MINIATURE_CANNON.Commentary: More damage on your best damage cards, what's not to love?  Prioritize upgrading your attacks if you have this, especially ones that hit multiple times.

MINIATURE_TENT.Commentary: You can think of this as adding a free heal to every Rest Site similar to Eternal Feather.  If you have additional Rest Site actions from another Relic this becomes a must-buy.  Excellent in Multiplayer because of the option to heal other players.

MINI_REGENT.Commentary: As long as you're spending Stars, the Strength scaling from this will add up very quickly.  This can provide your damage solution for Boss combats.

MIRAGE.Commentary: Very strong one-time block for decks with lots of poison, but it can also be a dead draw.  Somewhat niche.

MISERY.Commentary: Spreading debuffs is quite fun but not as useful as you might hope.  Unless you actually want a 0-cost attack you're better off with direct area effects.

MODDED.Commentary: Orb slots attached to a 0-cost draw card!  In longer fights you can invest additional energy to get even more slots.  In short fights, just play it once.

MOLTEN_EGG.Commentary: Most decks don't want a huge number of Attack cards, so this can be relatively few upgrades.  Extremely good if you get this in Act 1.

MOLTEN_FIST.Commentary: Can be nice to stack Vulnerable for Bully or Dominate, but needs a lot of support from other cards.  In the early game this can just be an attack with Exhaust.

MOMENTUM_STRIKE.Commentary: A functional early attack that can get you through Act I alongside a Hologram.  Has a lower top-end than many other attacks.

MONARCHS_GAZE.Commentary: This will reduce enemy Strength by 1 per hit for multihit cards like Radiate, so this is intended to block for you while you smack the enemy repeatedly.  The upgrade makes this much easier to get into play.  Very good in multiplayer since all players benefit from Strength down.

MONOLOGUE.Commentary: Somewhat underwhelming on its own, but this card can really shine when combined with some of Regent's multi-hit cards.  Radiate gets especially powerful when boosted by this.

MULTI_CAST.Commentary: A massive payoff card for decks with Dark or Plasma orbs.  Functions like Double Energy when used on Plasma, allowing for long combo turns.  Can also work with Thunder to create massive damage from a Lightning orb.

MUMMIFIED_HAND.Commentary: An extremely strong source of Energy for a deck with multiple powers.  You can manipulate the target of the effect by playing other cards in your hand first.

MURDER.Commentary: Slow and steady damage scaling gives you a way to kill high HP boss and elite enemies.  Any source of draw improves the damage, so mix and match!

MUSIC_BOX.Commentary: You still have to pay energy for the new copy.  Best with 0-cost cards or extra-strong attacks that you want to make more of.

MYSTIC_LIGHTER.Commentary: If you happen to have one or more Enchanted Attacks, then this is great!   Not really worth purchasing speculatively unless there's nothing else worth buying.

NECRO_MASTERY.Commentary: A nice way to get some area damage, or to turn Summon into a steady flow of damage against bosses.  Not great without other Summon cards.

NEGATIVE_PULSE.Commentary: Block + area damage is a combo that solves a lot of early- and mid-game combats.  Works best when combined with another source of area damage.

NEOWS_BONES.Commentary: Might be very strong, might also straddle you with multiple Curse cards.  Roll the dice if you're feeling lucky!

NEOWS_TALISMAN.Commentary: While not flashy, these two upgrades will significantly improve your opening combats and save you HP.  They can still be useful later in your run too.

NEOWS_TORMENT.Commentary: Quite powerful if you can pick up one or more 0-cost cards to return to your hand.

NEUROSURGE.Commentary: Powerful frontload card that wants you to end fights quickly after playing it.  Compare to cards like Offering or Biased Cognition.  Very strong if combined with a deck that has good output, or for getting other key cards in play.

NEUTRALIZE.Commentary: Weak at 0-cost is one of Silent's most consistently useful tools.  This is your best choice of upgrade if you get one from Neow.

NEUTRON_AEGIS.Commentary: A solid amount of plating for a high star cost.  The price of this card is a bit prohibitive and the effect isn't exactly game-winning, so there are often better uses for your stars.  Quite good if you can play it for free!

NEW_LEAF.Commentary: Has about a 1 in 3 chance of giving a Rare card.  Very solid start for most runs.

NIGHTMARE.Commentary: A very strong source of card multiplication.  Copy a power card to scale much higher, copy a 0-cost card for a next-turn burst, or just copy an enchanted or Ancient card for solid value!

NINJA_SCROLL.Commentary: A little bit of damage at the start is nice, but this will fill up your turn 1 hand and prevent you from benefiting from other turn 1 draw effects.  Avoid if you have any Relics that give you cards turn 1.

NOSTALGIA.Commentary: You can use this to play your best block card every turn or to re-draw cards that get stronger from repeat plays.  The card can be drawn immediately and played again if you want.  Especially good with Ancient cards.

NOT_YET.Commentary: A powerful sustain effect that you can use to fuel self-damage cards or just to heal damage back from combats.  You might need to skip playing this the first time and draw back into it later.

NOXIOUS_FUMES.Commentary: A steady flow of damage per turn lets you sit back and block to win once this is in play.  Best in decks with a very good block engine.
